title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade says nothing about a strategy. This note reports the live paper record as it stands at 2026-11-04T08:24:01.466Z, without projection.

## Open positions
The running record shows flat engines alongside open paper positions. htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 1 position open on paper: HYPEUSDT since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z. Separately, a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. Live starts are v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. A flat engine with 0 positions open is still a recorded state: it means the engine's rules have not produced an open paper position at the snapshot time. The HYPEUSDT position has been open since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z, while the NEAR position has been open since 12 October 2026. These open states come from different parts of the record and are reported as recorded. Because every entry here is paper, these states describe simulated exposure rather than money at risk.

## Closed trades and recent exits
The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The ATOM result of −17.9% is after the 30 bps round trip, so the percentage already includes that cost. The entry at 2.066 and exit at 1.703 are the prices in the record; the 10-day low rule is the stated exit condition. Closed-trade counts and averages by engine are: htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, average null net per trade; trend-daily-v005 closed trades so far: 5, average -13.68% net per trade; trend-daily-v006 closed trades so far: 5, average -13.68% net per trade. In testing, losing trades were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. A small number of closed trades cannot settle whether a rule works; it only records what happened. Closed averages are arithmetic summaries of completed paper trades, not forecasts. htf-rsi-v007's average is null because its completed trades do not yield a numeric average in the record. trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 both show -13.68% across 5 closed trades. The live starts differ: v005 counts from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026, so their samples are not directly comparable.

## Market filter and near-breakout distances
trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter on. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter on. The filter state is part of the engine's own record; it is not a comment on market direction. A market filter being on means the engine is applying its own condition; the record does not say what that condition predicts. The closest names to their 20-day breakout are: for trend-daily-v005, UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high, XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high, and BCHUSDT is 7.26% below its high; for trend-daily-v006, UNIUSDT is 3.15% below its high, HYPEUSDT is 5.29% below its high, and XRPUSDT is 6.50% below its high. The distances are expressed as percentage below high. UNIUSDT at 3.15% below its high is the nearest in both v005 and v006. HYPEUSDT at 5.29% below its high appears only in v006's list, while BCHUSDT at 7.26% appears only in v005's list. XRPUSDT at 6.50% appears in both. These distances are measurements from the record, not signals to act.

## Reading the record
Paper means the entries are simulated. The record can show an open position, a closed trade, and a percentage outcome, but it cannot show future performance. The ATOM exit at 1.703 is a realized paper outcome; the NEAR position at 5.896 remains unrealized; the HYPEUSDT position opened 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z remains open. The ATOM entry at 2.066 and exit at 1.703 are the prices in the record, and the 10-day low rule is the stated exit condition. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. The HYPEUSDT position since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z is the one open position in trend-daily-v006. The engines' states are read from the running record, including what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.

## Where to verify
The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The record updates continuously, so the snapshot above is a reading at 2026-11-04T08:24:01.466Z rather than a final statement. If a number in this note differs from the performance page or signal log, the live record governs because it was read at 2026-11-04T08:24:01.466Z. Nothing here is a recommendation, and no price targets are given. The purpose of the page is to show the engines' own state, including open positions, closed trades, and the market filter, in plain language. Framing remains paper signals only, with no real orders placed anywhere in this record.
